title: HogFlow status has no backend transition matrix; rules live in serializer validation and frontend
answers: Which HogFlow statuses can transition to which?
Does the backend enforce status transitions for workflows?
What happens when activating a draft workflow?
What extra restrictions apply to MCP callers?
body:
- `HogFlow.State` = draft|active|archived (backend/models/hog_flow/hog_flow.py). `HogFlowSerializer.status` is a plain ChoiceField: any status can be PATCHed to any other; no transition matrix.
- draft→active: `HogFlowSerializer.validate` re-validates stored actions with non-draft (strict) checks when payload has no `actions`. `to_internal_value` sets `context["is_draft"]` when target status != active, so draft/archived saves are lenient.
- MCP: `HogFlowViewSet.perform_create` rejects creating as ACTIVE; `perform_update` (`_is_mcp_request` block) forbids mixing status change with field edits and replacing actions/edges.
- `origin_product` (broadcasts = origin_product="broadcasts") is create-only; `HogFlowUpdateSerializer.validate` blocks changes.
- Editing an active flow stages `draft` JSON (`stage_draft`, `DRAFT_CONTENT_FIELDS`); live row changes only via `publish`, `restore_revision`, graph endpoint, or update without stage_draft.
- publish needs signed `confirm_token` from a preview (`mint_publish_confirm_token`), non-empty draft, strict revalidation; 409 `StaleWorkflowUpdateError` if draft changed.
- Concurrency: `base_updated_at` → 409 if stored row newer; `base_live_updated_at` fences live metadata write; `perform_update` uses select_for_update.
applies: Worker-side (Node/CDP) status enforcement was not inspected.

search: HogFlow status transitions have no backend-enforced matrix; draft, active, and archived states (HogFlow.State in models/hog_flow/hog_flow.py) are guarded only by serializer validation and frontend rules. Draft→active revalidates actions with strict rules; editing an active flow stages a draft JSON replica (stage_draft, DRAFT_CONTENT_FIELDS) without immediate live changes; publish requires a signed confirm token and strict revalidation with 409 StaleWorkflowUpdateError on concurrent modifications. Status changes cannot mix with field edits, actions, or edges; origin_product is create-only; concurrency is fenced by base_updated_at, base_live_updated_at, and select_for_update in HogFlowViewSet.perform_update. Applies to HogFlow state updates, serializer validation logic (HogFlowSerializer.validate), and multi-step publish workflows in products/workflows/backend/api/hog_flow.py.
